signals_note: Landed by registers.real_estate_authority.capture through the fetch gate. A page with the complaint-number heading but without the DECISION and COMPLAINT HISTORY pairs, or with a court heading but without DEFENDANT and DECISION, is not this shape and is set aside at stage recognise.
notes: Seen 2 November 2026 on all 3,062 abstracts held: every one carries DECISION, and all but the nine prosecutions COMPLAINT HISTORY; AGENT on 1,193 (the Authority names licensees where it made an adverse finding; 'No Further Action' decisions name nobody); where a suppression order is made the database prints no AGENT field. COMPLAINANT (222) names a member of the public and is not read. REASONING is read only for a suppression order and never kept (ruling 130).
